lintGate.provenance: Measured on canonical via eslint --format json, then re-verified independently inside the W2 worktree, which produced the identical 358. The ceiling is therefore a property of the tracked tree, not of one machine's working copy.
lintGate.provenEffective: Injecting a single new no-explicit-any makes the gate exit 1. It blocks new debt rather than reporting it.
lintGate.ratchetRule: Fix a surface, LOWER the ceiling, then promote that rule to error for that surface. Never raise the ceiling to accommodate new code, and never widen ignores to hide a finding.
lintGate.localVsCi: pnpm lint has no ceiling on purpose (a developer tree carries untracked files, so a fixed total is not reproducible locally). pnpm lint:ci is the gate and is what CI runs.
